Middle Ruby Developer for Digital Audit Confirmations Product,"**About the Project**
About Auditi

Auditi is offering two SaaS platform products to auditors. One is dealing with confirmations (internally “SBA”), a process during the end of year audit, and the other one is a file exchange specifically tailored to auditors and their clients (internally “PBC”).
We’re currently serving around 350 companies with more than 5.000 audit firm users and several thousand clients.
About Vispato
Vispato is offering an end-to-end encrypted whistleblowing system to companies. We’re also offering this tool to resellers who are selling the product under their own brand.

This is a brand new company and product serving a growing number of customers. Due to the EU whistleblowing directive becoming active in December, this will be an interesting space. Starting from that date companies with more than 250 employees will be required by law to offer a whistleblowing system to their employees and stakeholders.
**About the Team**

Currently, this project’s team consists of 6 professionals working from Germany and Ukraine, with exceptional technical expertise and soft skills, which significantly simplifies the process of communication.
**Responsibilities and Skills**
Responsibilities:

When working on the Auditi platform you will mostly deal with implementing new features for PBC and a new extension of the SBA product. The main SBA product is mostly in maintenance mode but doesn’t require a lot of attention as it is running very solid.
The tech stack is made up of a Ruby on Rails backend serving the API and the SBA product (frontend and backend). The new PBC app is built with Svelte.

When working on Vispato you will exclusively deal with implementing new features or extending existing ones. We’re still gathering feedback from sales calls and are making constant changes to the product to meet customer requirements.
The tech stack is made up of a Ruby on Rails application and a quite heavy Javascript frontend for the client-side end-to-end encryption.
**Skills:**
-3+ years of professional working experience
-Framework: Rails 5
-Database: PostgreSQL
-Backend: RoR, resque, redis
-Level of English (written and spoken) – at least Intermediate, preferably Upper-Intermediate
-Ability to deliver in time and be a team player
-A passion to be a part of something big and build a great product
-Frontend: stimulusjs, html/sass will be a Big plus
